name: SWKPLNT
recent: SWKPLNT 在 2026 年 11 月 20 日公布了截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度的业绩，并宣布第三次中期股息每股 7.5 仙。此前，公司多次公告其子公司与关联方 Sebubu Sdn. Bhd. 的油棕苗销售关联交易实际金额超出股东授权预估逾 10%。同期，多名大股东及董事（Datuk Amar Abdul Hamed bin Sepawi、Dato Wong Kuo Hea）多次申报股权变动。
notable: 宣布第三次中期股息每股 7.5 仙，除权日为 2026 年 12 月 22 日，派发日为 2027 年 1 月 21 日。
公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度的合并业绩。
子公司 Sarawak Plantation Agriculture Development Sdn. Bhd. 与关联方 Sebubu Sdn. Bhd. 的油棕苗销售关联交易实际金额多次超出股东授权预估逾 10%。
risks: 关联交易实际金额多次超出股东授权预估逾 10%，公司已就此发布公告。
大股东 Datuk Amar Abdul Hamed bin Sepawi 及董事 Dato Wong Kuo Hea 在 2026 年 9 月至 10 月间多次申报股权变动。

recent_en: SWKPLNT announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 20 November 2026 and declared a third interim dividend of 7.5 sen per share. Earlier, the company made several announcements that actual recurrent related party transactions for oil palm seedling sales between its subsidiary and Sebubu Sdn. Bhd. exceeded the mandated estimated value by more than 10%. Meanwhile, several substantial shareholders and directors (Datuk Amar Abdul Hamed bin Sepawi, Dato Wong Kuo Hea) filed multiple changes in their interests.
notable_en: Declared a third interim dividend of 7.5 sen per share, with ex-date on 22 December 2026 and payment date on 21 January 2027.
Announced consolidated results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026.

Actual value of recurrent related party transactions for oil palm seedling sales between subsidiary Sarawak Plantation Agriculture Development Sdn. Bhd. and related party Sebubu Sdn. Bhd. exceeded the shareholders' mandated estimated value by more than 10% on multiple occasions.
risks_en: Actual related party transaction value exceeded the shareholders' mandated estimated value by more than 10% on multiple occasions, and the company has made announcements on this.
Substantial shareholder Datuk Amar Abdul Hamed bin Sepawi and director Dato Wong Kuo Hea filed multiple changes in their interests between September and October 2026.
